verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Vercel has a CLI (vercel-probe-4, vercel-gh-1) that can be used as an alternative to Git-based deploys, and preview/production URLs can be locked down via authentication or passwords (vercel-docs-26), which supports the 'private until published' part of the story. However, no evidence explicitly describes a folder-upload (no-Git) deploy flow or confirms new deployments are private-by-default. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a drag-and-drop or CLI folder-upload deploy without any Git repo, and confirmation that such deployments default to private/unpublished state.
